title: Natural constant models from scalar-normalized module equivalences
statement:
Let $(C,J)$ be a site small in the coefficient universe with exact abelian sheafification and the closed sheafified tensor product [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor]. Let $B$ be a commutative ring and $R$ a commutative ring object of $\operatorname{Sh}(C,\operatorname{Ab})$, supplied with a ring-object map $\sigma:\underline B\to R$. Use internal module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Let
$$E:\operatorname{Mod}_R(\operatorname{Sh}(C,\operatorname{Ab}))\simeq\operatorname{Sh}(C,\operatorname{Mod}_B)$$
be an additive equivalence and fix $t:E(R)\cong\underline B$ such that, for every $b\in B$, $tE(\sigma(b)\cdot-)t^{-1}$ is multiplication by $b$ on $\underline B$. For a $B$-module $P$, let $M_R(P)=R\otimes_{\underline B}\underline P$ be extension of internal scalars [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars], where $\underline P$ is sheafification of the constant module presheaf. A finitely presented $B$-module means a module admitting an exact sequence $B^m\xrightarrow{q}B^n\to P\to0$ for finite $m,n$. There are isomorphisms
$$\theta_P:E(M_R(P))\xrightarrow{\sim}\underline P$$
natural in every linear map between finitely presented $B$-modules. For every such presentation, $\theta_P$ identifies the transported cokernel of the scalar matrix $\sigma(q):R^m\to R^n$ with the sheafified constant cokernel of $q:B^m\to B^n$, using $t$ on each free summand. The isomorphism is independent of the presentation and is the unique natural comparison with this normalization on finite free modules. If additive equivalences $E_U$ and regular-module identifications $t_U$ are supplied on each localized site $C/U$, together with coherent isomorphisms $E_U(M|_U)\cong E(M)|_U$ preserving these regular-module identifications and scalar endomorphisms, then the $\theta_P$ commute with all further localizations [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Consequently, on any specified covering family the existence of local models $M_{R|_U}(P_U)$ with finitely presented $P_U$ is equivalent to the existence of the corresponding constant local models $\underline{P_U}$ after applying $E$. Neither finiteness of $B$ nor a Noetherian or enough-points hypothesis is assumed.
